# ctables/make

> Slice allocation: `make([T], n)`: a 24-byte header and `n` zeroed elements.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/make.pkg) · translates [std/make](../std/make.md)

  A negative length calls `__pk_panic_len`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
__pk_make(
{n}
, {t.elemsize})
@alloc
```

Includes: [ctables/alloc](alloc.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
static W __pk_make(W n, W size) {
if (n < 0) __pk_panic_len();
W h = __pk_alloc(24);
W *hp = (W *)h;
hp[0] = __pk_alloc(n * size);
hp[1] = n;
hp[2] = n;
return h;
}
```
